properties.displayName: Bastion Shareable Links should be disabled
properties.description: The Bastion Shareable Link feature lets users connect to a target resource (virtual machine or virtual machine scale set) using Azure Bastion without accessing the Azure portal. Audits Bastion hosts unless shareable links are explicitly disabled. Audit by default; Deny can be selected for enforcement. Enabled=true checks all matching in-scope resources; false skips the check.

metadata.description: Start in audit mode. Only effects supported by the source definition are available.
True checks every matching resource within the assignment scope; false skips the check. Use assignment exclusions or exemptions for exceptions. Select true or false; defaults to true.
